verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is natural-language driven at its core. The docs show NL instructions driving real product actions: saving a procedure as a reusable skill (docs-42), scheduling recurring tasks from phrases like "run the tests every weekday at 9" (docs-31), delegating to sub-agents (docs-10), agentic web search (docs-41), and hands-free voice operation (docs-63, docs-24). Much of this agentic control is documented under the Computer ecosystem rather than the core web UI, and no evidence shows that admin settings or configuration can be changed by NL command. missing for 10: NL control of product settings/administration, independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.
